verdict.rationale: The docs define a skill spec (a directory with `SKILL.md` that must include `name` and `description`). They describe a built-in skill creator that interviews the user about purpose, triggers and scripts, and a recorder that drafts a skill from a demonstration. The built-in `@plugin-creator` meta-skill scaffolds the `.codex-plugin/plugin.json` manifest, folder and local marketplace entry for packaging, followed by a documented ZIP submission flow. A community user reports building their own skills with the skill-creator, and a probe installed the plugin-creator skill as a valid portable SKILL.md. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of an agent actually running the creator end to end to produce a packaged, installable skill.
